market.question: Will London have between 20-25mm of precipitation in May?

assessment.reasoning: Heathrow long-term May average is ~50mm. First 8 days of May 2026 were very dry (~2mm). Reaching only 20-25mm by month-end requires ~18-23mm over remaining 22 days, plausible for a drier-than-normal month but specific 5mm bucket is narrow. Without precise MTD totals, hard to verify.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Actual MTD rainfall total at Heathrow as of May 9
